One option is to do this: ```suggestion

  • Set value to ! Construct(%Temporal.PlainDate%, « serialized.[[ISODate]].[[Year]], serialized.[[ISODate]].[[Month]], serialized.[[ISODate]].[[Day]], serialized.[[Calendar]] »).

  • Set value to ! CreateTemporalDate(serialized.[[ISODate]], serialized.[[Calendar]]).

    • ``` Not sure whether it's OK to reference any abstract operation from ECMA-262 here. If it is, you can do something similar for all the clauses below, using CreateTemporalTime, CreateTemporalDuration, etc.
